import numpy as np, casa_tool, mujoco
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

s=casa_tool.Session('/app/instance.npz');m=s.model;d=s.data
arm_names=[f'robot0_joint{i}' for i in range(1,8)]
qadr=np.array([m.joint(n).qposadr[0] for n in arm_names]);dadr=np.array([m.joint(n).dofadr[0] for n in arm_names])
lo=np.array([m.joint(n).range[0,0] for n in arm_names]);hi=np.array([m.joint(n).range[0,1] for n in arm_names])
site=m.site('gripper0_right_grip_site').id
tmp=mujoco.MjData(m)
ori0=d.site_xmat[site].reshape(3,3).copy()

def ik(pos,ori=None,seed=None,orient_weight=0.15):
    if seed is None:seed=d.qpos[qadr].copy()
    if ori is None:ori=ori0
    target=np.asarray(pos)
    def error(q):
        tmp.qpos[:]=d.qpos;tmp.qpos[qadr]=q;mujoco.mj_forward(m,tmp)
        xyz=tmp.site_xpos[site];r=tmp.site_xmat[site].reshape(3,3)
        return np.r_[xyz-target,orient_weight*Rotation.from_matrix(ori@r.T).as_rotvec(),0.015*(q-seed)]
    out=least_squares(error,np.clip(seed,lo+0.005,hi-0.005),bounds=(lo+0.001,hi-0.001),max_nfev=80,ftol=1e-5)
    q=out.x
    print('IK',np.round(target,3),'error',np.round(error(q)[:6],3),'q',np.round(q,2),flush=True)
    return q

def move(pos,n=35,grip=-1,ori=None):
    q=ik(pos,ori)
    for i in range(n):
        a=s.hold_targets();a[:7]=q;a[7]=grip;a[12]=-1
        s.step(a)
    p=d.site_xpos[site].copy()
    print('MOVE',len(s.actions),'actual',np.round(p,3),'target',np.round(pos,3),'door',door(),flush=True)

def hold(n=20,grip=-1):
    for i in range(n):
        a=s.hold_targets();a[7]=grip;a[12]=-1;s.step(a)
    print('HOLD',len(s.actions),'site',np.round(d.site_xpos[site],3),'door',door(),flush=True)

def door():return float(d.qpos[m.joint('microwave_main_group_1_microjoint').qposadr[0]])

def main():
    print('start',np.round(d.site_xpos[site],3),'door',door(),flush=True)
    move([2.69,-0.95,1.68],35)
    move([2.75,-0.84,1.65],35)
    hold(25,1)
    for p in [[2.73,-0.92,1.65],[2.68,-1.01,1.65],[2.58,-1.10,1.65],[2.46,-1.15,1.65]]:
        move(p,20,1)
    print('FINAL',door())
    s.save_trajectory('/app/output/trajectory.npz')
if __name__=='__main__':main()
